Fire Station 3, a few hours later. Organized help still exists. For now.
Grab some water and catch your breath. You’re safe in here.
Engine 3, thirty-plus civilians trapped at Grove Market, barricaded inside. Roll out!
Engine 3, be advised: attacks are spreading along Main Row. Make it fast.
Doors coming open! Get them out, get them out!
All units, fall back. Evacuation point is the police checkpoint at the river bridge. Anyone who can move, go!
Over here! Move, move, we’re closing the gate!
